current_events: Ethiopian forces regain control of Adigrat in the Tigray Region following a withdrawal of Eritrean forces. Celebrations are reported in the city following the withdrawal
At least 20 people are killed and 18 others are injured in a Russian airstrike on a five-story residential building in Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine
Twelve people are killed and 309 more injured in a Houthi missile attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
October 2026 King Khalid International Airport attack
The National Hurricane Center reports that Isaias has weakened to a post-tropical cyclone after making landfall near Destin, Florida, United States
Four people are reported dead after Isaias made landfall in the US, with two deaths reported in Escambia County, Florida, and another two in Alabama
Simon strengthens into a category 4 Pacific hurricane with 150 mph (240 kph) in winds as it barrels towards Mexico's coast
A man is killed after jumping into a tiger enclosure and being attacked at Yorkshire Wildlife Park in South Yorkshire, England
Indian authorities are placing New Delhi under a security lockdown and have been detaining thousands of demonstrators to block a rally organized by the Gen Z-led Cockroach Janta Party
In association football, the match between Rayo Vallecano and Athletic Bilbao is abandoned due to fans throwing objects at the pitch to protest against Rayo president Raúl Martín Presa

In American college football, the Kentucky Wildcats football team defeats the LSU Tigers, 35–34, on a 2-point conversion in overtime, becoming the first team in FBS history to win consecutive overtime games by one point since overtime was introduced in 1996
2026 NCAA Division I FBS football season
In cycling, the 120th edition of the Giro di Lombardia is held in Italy, with Paul Seixas winning the race and becoming the youngest person to do so
